data.title: 阿尔托莉雅 · 银杏长椅边的热茶
data.description: 银杏树下的木长椅上，阿尔托莉雅穿藏蓝牛角扣呢大衣，象牙白围巾垂在胸前，绿蓝格纹中裙整齐铺在并拢的膝上。她双手捧着暖茶纸杯，低头闻茶香，杯口蒸汽在斜阳中显得很轻。椅端放着合拢的小食纸袋，近处木条与落叶清楚可见；石砖步道从椅背后绕过，低矮石栏将步道与更远的草坪分开。左后方夕照穿过黄叶，勾亮围巾和盘发上的蓝丝带，杯子与手指保持柔和亮面，长椅、鞋边和树下各有落影。
data.location: 秋日公园银杏树下长椅，后方弯曲步道越过低石栏通向草坪
data.action: 双膝并拢坐在长椅上，双手捧暖茶纸杯，低头闻茶香并露出浅笑。
data.lighting: golden-hour sun from the back left through ginkgo leaves; warm rim on scarf and blue hair ribbon
data.camera: medium shot, eye level, seated portrait with knees, bench and curving path visible
data.promptProse: Seated with her knees together, she cups the warm tea in both hands beneath her face and smiles at its rising steam. Low sunlight from behind her left shoulder catches the scarf and blue hair ribbon, with shadows under the bench and beside her boots. The stone path curves behind the bench, a low stone railing separating it from the lawn beyond.
data.animaCaption: She cups the tea beneath her face, sunlight behind her left shoulder.
